name: apex-project
description: Apex Ammunition & Components - ammunition catalog, cost calculator, and reloading reference.
//license: NOT DECLARED - and that is a decision for the owner, not a cleanup.
This project is `private: true` and is not published to npm, so nothing
requires a license today. The default without one is 'all rights reserved',
which means nobody else may legally reuse the domain physics, the drag
tables, or the data pipeline. If Apex AMC is ever to be open source, add a
LICENSE file AND set "license" here. See docs/REVIEW.md P3-1.

scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:ballistics
scripts.data:extract: node scripts/extract/extract-kwk-pressures.mjs && node scripts/extract/extract-leverguns-pressures.mjs && node scripts/extract/extract-vihtavuori-burn-rate.mjs && node scripts/extract/crosscheck-pressures.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:website && npm run test:affiliate
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:all && npm run test:all && npm run test:encoding && npm run test:bullets && npm run schema:check && npm run seed:check && npm run data:validate && npm run docs:check && npm run handoff:status && npm run security:check && npm run modules:check && npm run website:check && npm run claims:check && npm run tasks:check && npm run oracle:check && npm run ci:check && npm run audit:check
scripts.website:build: npm run build --workspace apps/website && npm run website:csp
